notes: Final shared graph equality covers all build inputs, including 474 Haskell dependency/build-tool instances.
Tests remain disabled exactly as in the original Nix recipe; validation runs four database-free CLI behavior comparisons and eleven identity probes.
Linking remains included in builder buildPhase; peak builder memory is unmeasured. No compiler or parallelism tuning was adopted.
An initial measurement-harness run was interrupted during migration to include evaluation/IFD in timed invocations. None of its timings enters this receipt.
Initial trial source filtering used the equivalent absolute-path predicate on resolved temporary paths; final filter also works through symlinked paths. Final recipe identity was verified equal.

reproduction_script.note: Final runner includes post-start receipt and interruption-handling improvements; measured build commands and timing boundaries are unchanged.
